pageTitle: Your notice proposing a new rent
questionTitle: Do you think the notice is legally valid?
validSection13: Your landlord must give you a valid section 13 notice before increasing your rent.
bullet1: give the correct notice period (at least 2 months)
bullet2: not increase the rent within 52 weeks of the last increase
bullet3: start the increase on the correct date
bullet4: include your correct details, such as your name and address
stillChallengeIncrease: You can still challenge the rent increase even if the notice is valid.
mustStillSubmitApplication: If you think the notice is not valid, you must still submit this market rent determination application.

noticeNotLegallyValidReason.label: Explain why the notice is not legally valid (optional)
noticeNotLegallyValidReason.hint: You can upload supporting evidence next
